sentences.text: Staphylococcus aureus is a frequent cause of infection in both community and hospital settings, and the nose is the main ecological niche where it resides in people.
Carriage in the anterior nares follows three patterns: roughly twenty per cent of healthy people are persistent carriers, sixty per cent intermittent, and twenty per cent almost never carry it.
In a multicentre study of bacteraemia, blood isolates were identical to the patient's own nasal isolates in 180 of 219 patients.
Commensal neighbours can limit it: a serine protease secreted by some Staphylococcus epidermidis strains inhibited its biofilm formation and nasal colonisation.
A randomised trial reported that treating nasal carriers with mupirocin ointment and chlorhexidine soap lowered hospital-associated Staphylococcus aureus infection from 7.7 to 3.4 per cent.
